crop.notes: Whole 'Reflections' column of race-track quips from the Sporting page.

title.suggested: Tom Allen loses at the Fair Grounds races

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican's joking notes on the Fair Grounds races said Tom Allen, the ex-champion pugilist, was "knocked out in the first round," a jest about his betting losses.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Republican: St. Louis, Saturday Morning, September 12, 1885' - the Missouri Republican (renamed St. Louis Republic only in 1888).

notes: One-line mention; 'knocked out in the first round' is a betting pun, not a fight. Current title could be read as a real knockout.
